Two travelers asked the same guard the same question. They got opposite answers.

Kevin Trudeau tells an ancient story. A man arrives at a city wall and says the people in his old city were mean and dishonest. The guard tells him he will find the same people here.

Another man says his old neighbors were wonderful and hardworking. The guard tells him he will find the same people here too.

Kevin's point: what you find in others starts with what you carry in your own mind.

What do you usually expect to find in people?

#ad #mindset #success #kevintrudeau

Would you take success advice from someone who never built anything?

Kevin Trudeau tells the story of his friend Ed Forman, who trained famous speakers. Ed built real companies in oil, real estate, concrete and restaurants before he ever gave a talk on success.

He did not earn his living selling courses on how to earn. He earned it in real life.

So when he spoke, people said one thing: he knows.

Who in your life really knows what they are talking about?
